messages:
alicia: Quick heads-up — I'm seeing a regression when running fused RoPE + FlashAttention paged path. Repro on canary: batch=1, seq=2048, rotary_scale=0.5, rotary_dim=64. Latency ~2x vs last stable. Profiling attached below.

benjamin: Can you paste the raw numbers and the perf flamegraph link? any config flags?

alicia: Yep — minimal repro and results: 
```
# bench command
./bench --model=gpt-like --seq=2048 --batch=1 --attn=paged_flash --rope=scaled --rotary-dim=64

# summary
tokens/s: 1200
p50: 42ms
p95: 220ms
# baseline (last week) tokens/s: ~2300, p95: ~110ms
```
Link to flamegraph: https://internal.redwood/fg/1889004321 (internal).

cheng: Interesting — kernel selector picked FLASH_PAGED_FUSED for that config. My hypothesis: scaled RoPE changes effective q/k layout and for rotary_dim=64 we lose 32-byte alignment so the fused kernel falls back to an odd codepath that increases memory shuffling.

marta: Also seeing increased KV read stalls in the paged path. perf top showed a lot of time in memcpy-like routines when reading packed pages. Seems like page packing for KV doesn't account for ALiBi/shifted positions, causing extra adjustments per token.

benchmark-bot: nightly-bench: paged_flash (rope_scaled, rot_dim=64, b=1, seq=2048) -> 1.2k toks/s, p95 220ms (+95% vs baseline). Attach: /artifacts/bench/1889004321/report.json

benjamin: Quick mitigation idea: change selector heuristic to prefer FLASH_PAGED_BASELINE when rotary_scale != 1.0 OR rotary_dim % 32 != 0. That avoids the fused path's misaligned vector loads. I'll sketch a patch. Also adding a --force-kernel flag to bench harness so we can A/B easily.

cheng: Good start. Two more things to check: 1) KV cache page stride — ensure read/write alignments are preserved when we apply ALiBi shifts (we might be doing per-token adjustments that break memcpy-friendly layout). 2) Batching heuristics: for batch=1 we may want to fall back to a single-stream optimized kernel rather than the fused multi-stream path.

marta: I'll run an overnight sweep: seq=[512,1024,2048], batch=[1,2,4], kernels=[fused,baseline], rot_scale=[0.5,1.0], rot_dim=[32,64,128]. Will post a matrix. Starting now. :ram:

alicia: Thanks — follow-ups: @benjamin please open a small selector patch and bench flag. @cheng can you add a microbenchmark that isolates KV page read throughput with and without ALiBi shifts? @marta share the matrix results and any heap/profile traces. If mitigation looks good we can ship a hotfix to canary.

benjamin: On it — will cc eng-runtime and roll a canary tomorrow.

cheng: I'll prototype the KV microbench today and dump flamegraphs. Suspect we can get most wins by avoiding the fused kernel for non-32-aligned rotary dims.

marta: uploaded first sweep snapshot: /artifacts/bench/1889004321/matrix_v1.csv. Early note: fused wins at batch>=2 for seq<=1024 but fails at b=1/seq=2048 with scaled rope.

alicia: Perfect. If we confirm selector rule reduces p95 by ~40% we can enable as temporary policy. Thanks everyone.

(reacts: alicia :thumbsup:, benjamin :eyes:, marta :rocket:)
